standard_seat_rate_note: List price of the downgrade-target seat tier; used in the premium-underutilized savings estimate. Set this to your plan's standard (non-premium) seat price.
premium_utilization_note: A premium seat is flagged as a downgrade candidate if its overage in the latest full month is below this floor.
reclaim_note: A seat is a reclaim candidate if prompt+completion tokens stayed below reclaim_tokens_floor in each of the last reclaim_months_lookback full months.
consistent_overage_note: Flag a user at/above consistent_overage_floor_usd of overage for consistent_overage_months periods running — check for runaway automation or a mis-sized seat.
frontier_share_note: Products whose frontier-vs-cheaper model mix feeds the what-if routing panel. Model families themselves are defined in models.json.
spike_note: A product's overage is flagged as a spike when month-over-month growth >= spike_mom_pct AND the later month is >= spike_min_usd.
